status: Reproduced and fixed; original-profile acceptance pending
userReport: Browser crashed after something downloaded during a random Chrome Web Store extension install
rootCause: The native manager rejected a Chromium-created post-install browser too early. A queued ExtensionInstalledWatcher completion callback then accessed its closed active tab.
fix: Suppress native show requests for rejected Chrome windows
Add one UI queue turn before Chromium schedules destructive close, preserving its already-queued completion callback
Track auxiliary browsers through OnBeforeClose and drain them on workspace removal/shutdown
Reject auxiliary navigation and isolate its callbacks from visible manager state
Retain existing toolbar-free appearance, native permission confirmation, TLS and package verification

fixture.nativeConfirmationDriver: Fixed Windows UI Automation invocation inside the disposable fixture process

reproductions.note: Full native-confirmed Store-install reproduction hit the auxiliary completion callback. Debugger used a nearby optimized symbol name; the later stack identified TriggerPostInstallDialog and ExtensionInstalledWatcher.
Experimental infobar-feature workaround did not repair the successful-install continuation; removed.
Experimental hidden-toolbar workaround did not repair the continuation; removed.
